name: Unseen Shadow

skills.name: Dance of the Eternal Night
skills.description: Hedalet releases 12 flying daggers around him; 2 seconds after fully spreading out, all daggers fly back to Unseen Shadow's position, and each time they pass through an enemy they deal Frost DMG equal to 62.5% of Spell Power to it.

scaling.text: Frost DMG equal to 62.5% of Spell Power

skills.name: Shadowstep
skills.description: Hedalet teleports behind the enemy with the least HP, dealing Frost damage of 120% (affected by spell power) to the current target, and stealing 10% of the target's current rage if it critically hits.

scaling.text: Frost DMG equal to 120% of Spell Power

skills.name: Anger Management
skills.description: Attack Speed increased by 25%; each of Hedalet's attacks destroys 10 (additionally affected by Spell Mastery) Rage of the target.

skills.name: Deathly Hallows
skills.description: The spell cloak created by Hedalet makes him take Spell DMG only once per 1 second, and reduces that DMG by 6% (additionally affected by Spell Mastery).

skills.name: Folded Steel
skills.description: Hedalet's loyal service to the Goddess of Night is rewarded, increasing Hedalet's Skill Crit% by 15%. Dance of the Eternal Night has a 10% + 2% * Spell Mastery chance on hit to apply the Chill effect.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.description: Each time a teammate casts an ultimate, Hedalet gains [Energy Transfer]: Attack Speed increased by 6%, DMG increased by 6% (stack limit: 25). In addition, when Hedalet dies, he shares 100% of his current Rage evenly among all surviving allied units.

skills.name: Bully
skills.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with lower spell power or physical power by 12%

skills.name: Lethal Ambush
skills.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with full health by 15%

skills.name: Shadowmeld
skills.description: When taking damage, there is a 10% chance to trigger Shadowmeld, immune to the damage, and immune to all damage for the next 0.2 sec. (Trigger interval 10 sec).
